textRuns.value: Same 182 cells, same leaf measures ([NM Total Income] and friends), same year filter. Page 6 dispatches with a field parameter on the rows and a calculation group on the columns. This page dispatches with fourteen SWITCH ( TRUE ( ), … ) measures of thirteen branches each.
Because the row column is GROUPED, branch pruning cannot fire: every branch of every measure is reachable, so the engine plans all 182.
This is deliberately the FAIR version of the comparison: the branches call the same efficient leaves rather than rebuilding a measure pyramid. It isolates dispatch and nothing else.
